pages.title: Daddy Pig Smiling in His Round Glasses Outside the Family House Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig smiles outside the family house in this printable coloring page, wearing his familiar round glasses with both arms spread beside his large oval body. The house's windows, front door, tiled roof, and chimney rise behind him, with a round sun, bushes, and grass tufts around the garden.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Reading a Newspaper in His Armchair Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig reads a newspaper in his armchair in this printable coloring page, holding the open pages with both hands beneath his round glasses and smile. Rectangular picture boxes and lines divide the newspaper, while the chair's curved back, padded arms, cushion, and short feet frame the seated character.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Looking for His Lost Glasses with Peppa and George Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig looks for his lost glasses with Peppa and George in this printable coloring page, touching his chin while the children share his puzzled expression. A bookcase, framed picture, floor lamp, armchair, oval rug, and low table furnish the living room where the family is searching.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Telling Peppa and George a Bedtime Story Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig tells Peppa and George a bedtime story in this printable coloring page, sitting beside their bed with an open book decorated with stars and a moon. The children smile beneath a spotted blanket, while matching dotted curtains frame a window showing a crescent moon and stars outside.

pages.title: Daddy Pig and Mummy Pig Sharing a Family Hug with Peppa and George Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig and Mummy Pig share a family hug with Peppa and George in this printable coloring page, gathering close together with smiling faces and open arms. The parents stand behind the children, and their simple clothing, round cheeks, curly tails, and Daddy Pig's glasses define the group portrait.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Cradling Baby Evie While Peppa and George Watch Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig cradles baby Evie in this printable coloring page, holding the smiling baby in a wrapped blanket while Peppa and George watch from either side below. Evie wears a bow near her ear, and the family's round cheeks, open smiles, and simple outlines fill the otherwise plain background.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Flipping a Pancake in the Kitchen with George Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig flips a pancake in the kitchen in this printable coloring page, holding a frying pan while George watches the pancake turn in midair above it. A mixing bowl and spoon rest on the foreground table, with an oven, sink, cabinets, and dotted window curtains behind the pair.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Cooking a Barbecue in the Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig cooks a barbecue in the garden in this printable coloring page, holding a slotted spatula above a round grill while Peppa and George watch nearby. Sausages and burgers sit on the grate beneath curling heat lines, with a fence, bushes, grass tufts, and sun completing the outdoor scene.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Eating Dinner at the Table with Mummy Pig and the Children Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig eats dinner with Mummy Pig, Peppa, and George in this printable coloring page, with the family seated around a round table holding their forks. Four filled plates surround a large serving bowl and spoon, while simple chairs and an open background keep attention on the shared meal.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Blowing Out the Candles on His Birthday Cake Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig blows out his birthday candles in this printable coloring page, leaning toward a round cake while Peppa and George smile with their arms raised. Five striped candles stand above a wavy icing edge, and short curved lines beside his mouth show the blowing action over the party table.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Performing a Magic Trick at Peppa's Birthday Party Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig performs a magic trick at Peppa's birthday party in this printable coloring page, holding a wand and a top hat with a rabbit inside. His cape and bow tie match the party theme, with Peppa, George, balloons, bunting, wrapped presents, and a candle-topped cake surrounding the act.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Filming Peppa and George with His Movie Camera Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig films Peppa and George with his movie camera in this printable coloring page, standing behind a tripod while the children lift their arms and feet. Two round reels sit above the camera body, with a broad lens facing the pair across a grassy garden dotted with bushes.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Playing the Accordion While Peppa Plays Her Drum Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig plays the accordion while Peppa plays her drum in this printable coloring page, with the smiling pair holding their instruments against a plain background. The accordion has piano keys, round buttons, and zigzag bellows, while Peppa's drum hangs from a strap beneath two round-tipped beaters.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Hanging a Picture of Peppa and George on the Wall Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig hangs a picture of Peppa and George in this printable coloring page, holding the rectangular frame steady while the children look up at their portrait. A triangular hanging cord reaches the wall hook above, and a table lamp sits on a chest of drawers beside the family.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Painting a Cherry Tree on an Easel in the Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig paints a cherry tree in this printable coloring page, holding a palette and brush beside an easel while Peppa and George watch in the garden. Blossoms and paired cherries appear on both the canvas and nearby tree, with a picket fence, flowers, clouds, and sun completing the scene.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Showing Peppa and George a Drawing at His Office Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig shows Peppa and George a drawing at his office in this printable coloring page, pointing to a house, tree, and sun on the paper. A wheeled desk chair, computer, keyboard, pencil cup, binders, potted plant, and framed landscape furnish the workspace around the smiling family.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Returning His Overdue Book at the Library Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig returns his overdue book at the library in this printable coloring page, smiling in his round glasses beside the counter where the closed book rests. Tall shelves hold rows of books in different sizes, while an arched window and a smaller bookcase fill the background behind him.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Pushing a Shopping Trolley at the Supermarket Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig pushes a shopping trolley through the supermarket in this printable coloring page, holding the handle with both hands beside shelves packed with groceries behind him. Apples, a bottle, and a box sit inside the wire basket, with jars, cans, cartons, and tiled flooring completing the shop setting.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Hanging His Football Shirt on the Washing Line Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig hangs his football shirt on the washing line in this printable coloring page, fastening a peg beside the shirt's V-shaped collar and ball emblem. A basket of laundry rests on the grass below, with a tall line post, picket fence, and bushes framing the garden chore.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Sorting Bottles at the Recycling Centre with Peppa and George Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig sorts bottles at the recycling centre in this printable coloring page, holding one above a collection bin while Peppa and George watch beside him. A bottle symbol marks the bin's front beneath its round opening, with more containers, a shelter roof, and a fence in the background.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Washing the Family Car with a Sponge and Bucket Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig washes the family car in this printable coloring page, pressing a sponge against the bubbly door while George holds another sponge beside a bucket. Peppa watches nearby, with puddles under the bucket and the family house, trees, clouds, and sun behind the car on the hill.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Assembling a Toy Cupboard with Mr Zebra Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig assembles a toy cupboard with Mr Zebra in this printable coloring page, holding a hammer while his helper uses a screwdriver beside the partly built shelves. Peppa and George watch among loose boards and screws, with a box of toys and dotted window curtains completing the room.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Helping Mummy Pig Fix Her Computer Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig helps Mummy Pig fix her computer in this printable coloring page, using a screwdriver beside the open case while Peppa and George watch below. A cooling fan and cables are visible inside the tower, with a monitor, keyboard, mouse, wheeled chair, and dotted curtains around the desk.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Jumping in a Muddy Puddle in His Rain Boots Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig jumps in a muddy puddle in this printable coloring page, lifting his rain boots into the air while Peppa and George smile beside him. Large droplets splash around his feet, and the children wear their own boots on the grassy ground beneath a row of low bushes.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Flying a Kite with Peppa and George Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig flies a kite with Peppa and George in this printable coloring page, holding a spool and guiding the string toward a diamond-shaped kite overhead. Four ribbon bows decorate its tail, while the children look up from a flower-dotted lawn beneath rounded clouds and a bright outlined sun.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Making Giant Bubbles with an Old Tennis Racket Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig makes giant bubbles with an old tennis racket in this printable coloring page, raising the racket while Peppa and George reach toward the floating shapes. One elongated bubble stretches from the racket's mesh, with smaller round bubbles drifting above the garden beneath the sun and clouds.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Riding His Bicycle Along a Country Path with Peppa Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig rides his bicycle along a country path with Peppa in this printable coloring page, the two smiling riders holding handlebars above their spoked wheels. Front lamps and pedals detail the bicycles, while a post-and-rail fence, rolling hills, trees, flowers, and clouds surround the curving route.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Watching Football with His Family Beside a Trophy-shaped Cake Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig watches football with his family in this printable coloring page, cheering beside Mummy Pig while Peppa and George sit near a trophy-shaped cake. A match appears on the television, and football emblems decorate the cake beneath the handled cup, with a sofa, cushions, and oval rug around them.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Running a Charity Race with a Number on His Shirt Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig runs a charity race in this printable coloring page, wearing trainers and a shirt with a large number one pinned across the front below his glasses. His arms and legs stretch into a running stride, with course ribbons, grass tufts, trees, and bushes behind him.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Doing Press-ups While Peppa Counts Beside Him Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig does press-ups while Peppa counts in this printable coloring page, supporting himself on his hands and toes on the lawn outside their family house. Peppa holds up one hand beside him, while the house windows, roof aerial, low bushes, a sun, and a rounded cloud fill the background.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Helping George Swim with Armbands at the Swimming Pool Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig helps George swim with armbands in this printable coloring page, reaching toward him in the pool while Peppa watches from the tiled edge above. Ripples and small splashes surround the pair, with a pool ladder, perimeter railing, bushes, and a round sun completing the swimming scene.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Ice Skating with Peppa and George Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig ice skates with Peppa and George in this printable coloring page, holding each child's hand while gliding across the ice in a fringed scarf. Curved skate tracks sweep beneath their blades, with snowy hills and four fir trees stretching across the background behind the smiling family.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Helping Peppa and George Build a Snowman Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig helps Peppa and George build a snowman in this printable coloring page, reaching toward its pom-pom hat while the children hold round snowballs nearby. The snowman has a carrot nose, dotted smile, scarf, and twig arms, with bare trees and snowy hills completing the winter setting.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Taking Peppa and George for a Snowy Sledge Ride Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George on a snowy sledge ride in this printable coloring page, sitting behind the children as they hold the front pull ropes. All three wear scarves, and the children have bobble hats, with falling snow and fir trees surrounding the sloping hill and curved runners.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Enjoying a Picnic with His Family Beside a Pond Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig enjoys a picnic beside a pond with Peppa and George in this printable coloring page, sharing sandwiches on a checkered blanket beneath a leafy tree. A woven basket and platter of sandwiches and apples sit nearby, while two ducks, reeds, lily pads, and a water lily fill the pond.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Feeding Ducks with Peppa and George at the Pond Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig feeds ducks with Peppa and George in this printable coloring page, holding an open food bag while pieces fall toward the pond beside the children. Three ducks float among circular ripples below them, with reeds on the water's edge and a fence, tree, and bushes behind the family.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Wearing a Captain's Hat and Steering Grandpa Pig's Boat Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig steers Grandpa Pig's boat in this printable coloring page, wearing an anchor-badged captain's hat while Peppa and George stand beside him on the deck. His hands hold the large spoked wheel, with a cabin porthole, flag, wooden planks, rippling sea, and distant hills adding nautical detail.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Driving the Family Car Along a Winding Country Road Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig drives the family car along a winding country road in this printable coloring page, with Peppa and George smiling from the open rear seats. Seat belts cross the riders, while round headlights, mirrors, dashed road markings, rolling hills, trees, and a fence define the countryside journey.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Putting Up a Tent at the Family Campsite Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig puts up a tent at the family campsite in this printable coloring page, gripping the front support pole while Peppa and George watch nearby. The triangular tent has an open entrance and ground pegs, with fir trees, bushes, grass, a sun, and one cloud across the landscape.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Checking a Map Beside the Family Camper Van Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig checks a map beside the family camper van in this printable coloring page, holding the unfolded sheet while Peppa and George look up at him. Dashed routes, hills, and a tree mark the map, with the van's large windshield, mirrors, roof section, and side door behind them.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Buried in Beach Sand Beside Peppa and George's Sandcastle Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig is buried in beach sand in this printable coloring page, smiling above the mound beside Peppa's spade, George's bucket, and their three-towered sandcastle below. Small flags top the castle, while shells, pebbles, gentle waves, clouds, and an outlined sun fill the seaside scene around the family.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Following Animal Footprints on a Woodland Nature Trail Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig follows animal footprints on a woodland nature trail in this printable coloring page, carrying a backpack and magnifying glass with Peppa and George beside him. Paw prints curve along the path ahead, with tall trees, leafy bushes, stones, grass tufts, and a fallen log lining the route.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Admiring the View From Windy Castle with Peppa Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig admires the view from Windy Castle with Peppa in this printable coloring page, standing behind stone battlements as she points across the landscape below. A flag flies beside the round tower, while hills, a winding stretch of water, trees, and a small village extend into the distance.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Showing Peppa and George the Stars Through a Telescope Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig shows Peppa and George the stars through a telescope in this printable coloring page, standing beside the long tube aimed upward from its tripod. The children smile beneath a crescent moon and outlined stars, with low bushes and tufts of grass marking their garden stargazing spot.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Visiting the Museum's Moon Exhibition with Peppa and George Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig visits the museum's moon exhibition with Peppa and George in this printable coloring page, looking toward an enormous cratered moon model behind rope barriers. A spacesuit in a display case, a rocket on a stand, and hanging planet models provide more exhibits around the smiling family.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Riding in a Hot Air Balloon with His Family Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig rides in a hot air balloon with his family in this printable coloring page, sharing a woven basket with Mummy Pig, Peppa, and George. Long suspension ropes connect the basket to a large paneled balloon, with a burner overhead and clouds above the rolling hills far below.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Hanging Decorations on the Christmas Tree with Peppa Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig hangs decorations on the Christmas tree with Peppa in this printable coloring page, reaching toward a bauble while she holds a large star ornament. A star already tops the tree above bead garlands, round ornaments, and candy canes, with an open decoration box resting on the floor.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Giving Mummy Pig Flowers on Valentine's Day Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig gives Mummy Pig flowers on Valentine's Day in this printable coloring page, presenting a wrapped bouquet tied with a large bow as she clasps her hands. Three outlined hearts float above the smiling parents, while Peppa and George raise their arms in the foreground below the flowers.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Taking Peppa and George Trick-or-treating on Halloween Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George trick-or-treating in this printable coloring page, wearing a cape beside Peppa's witch hat and George's spotted dinosaur costume on Halloween night. Each carries a pumpkin bucket, with a jack-o'-lantern on the doorstep and a lantern, crescent moon, and stars above the path.

pages.title: Daddy Pig Visiting the Optician for New Glasses with Peppa and George Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig visits the optician for new glasses in this printable coloring page, sitting beside Peppa and George while a rabbit optician holds a round pair. Shelves display circular, rectangular, and heart-shaped frames, with an oval wall mirror and a tray of glasses completing the shop interior.

pages.title: Peppa Pig Daddy Pig Looking Around in Aquarium Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig looks around an aquarium in this printable coloring page, walking beside a large glass tank filled with small fish above branching coral and rocks. His simple round body and curly tail stand in the foreground, while another tank and low visitor railings extend along the gallery behind him.

pages.title: Peppa Pig Daddy Pig Waving in Museum Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig waves at the museum in this printable coloring page, wearing a jacket and tie beside a dinosaur skeleton displayed on a raised rectangular platform. The fossil's toothed skull and rib cage tower behind him, with rope barriers and a wall case holding a vase nearby.

pages.title: Peppa Pig Daddy Pig Jumping in Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig jumps inside a castle courtyard in this printable coloring page, lifting his arms and feet beside Peppa above puddles on the cobbled ground below. An open arched doorway, crenellated stone walls, narrow pointed window, and flag-topped tower frame the pair in the background.

pages.title: Peppa Pig Daddy Pig Standing in Forest Trail Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig stands on a forest trail in this printable coloring page, smiling in his round glasses and a three-button outfit with lace-up shoes beneath him. The path curves between tall leafy trees, while bushes, grass tufts, and scattered small stones fill the woodland around the full-body portrait.

pages.title: Peppa Pig Daddy Pig Standing in Camping Area Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig stands in a camping area in this printable coloring page, holding a fishing rod beside a stone-ringed campfire and a wooden picnic table nearby. A dome tent is pitched behind him, with rolling hills, deciduous trees, firs, rocks, bushes, and grass filling the sunny campsite.

pages.title: Peppa Pig Daddy Pig Resting In Canyon Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig rests in a canyon in this printable coloring page, reclining in a hammock suspended between the rocky walls with his arms stretched outward beside him. Stripes cross his shirt above the curved hammock, while cracks and layered lines detail the cliffs beneath a sun and four clouds.

pages.title: Peppa Pig Daddy Pig Walking In Town Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig walks through town with Peppa in this printable coloring page, holding her hand as they smile along a broad cobblestone street between small buildings. A central clock tower rises behind them, while rows of windows, simple trees, chimney-topped roofs, and three clouds complete the town view.

pages.title: Peppa Pig Daddy Pig Jumping In Simple Room Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig jumps in a simple room in this printable coloring page, lifting both feet and spreading his arms while Peppa stands smiling with her hands raised. An oval rug lies in the foreground, with a four-pane window and an empty rectangular picture frame on the wall behind the pair.

pages.title: Peppa Pig Daddy Pig Looking Around In Open Field Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig looks around an open field in this printable coloring page, standing beside Peppa as she carries a small toy against her dress beneath the sun. Flowers line the foreground among scattered grass tufts, while low hills and a small bush form the simple countryside background behind them.

pages.title: Peppa Pig Daddy Pig Exploring In Sand Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig explores the sand with Peppa in this printable coloring page, holding a small spade while she carries a bucket containing a starfish beside him. Two shells and pebbles rest on the sand, with rounded dunes, three distant palm trees, and a small sun across the background.

pages.title: Peppa Pig Daddy Pig Standing Confidently In Tunnel Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig stands confidently in a tunnel in this printable coloring page, resting his hands on his hips while Peppa smiles beside him beneath the rounded entrance. Broad curved outlines and wall seams define the passage, with simple oval ground shadows and open space around the two characters.

pages.title: Peppa Pig Daddy Pig Pointing In Jungle Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig points through the jungle in this printable coloring page, standing beside Peppa beneath curling overhead vines and a border of large tropical plant leaves. His glasses and stubble distinguish his smiling face, while broad split leaves, narrow fronds, low bushes, and small stones surround the pair.

pages.title: Peppa Pig Daddy Pig Observing In Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig observes the view from a tower in this printable coloring page, standing beside Peppa on an open balcony beneath a tall pointed pavilion roof. Two large arched windows decorate the tower below them, while a sun and four rounded clouds surround the building against the open sky.

pages.title: Peppa Pig Daddy Pig Resting In Desert Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig rests in the desert in this printable coloring page, lying on a rectangular mat beside Peppa with sleeping marks floating above his tilted head. A wide-brimmed hat rests near his feet, while three cacti, two pointed peaks, rolling dunes, and a round sun surround the resting spot.

pages.title: Peppa Pig Daddy Pig Posing In Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig poses beside Peppa at a castle in this printable coloring page, spreading one arm as they stand smiling before the arched double entrance doors. Two pointed towers flank a tiled central roof, with narrow windows, battlements, a flying flag, and three small clouds completing the castle backdrop.

pages.title: Peppa Pig Daddy Pig Running In Valley Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig runs through a valley with Peppa in this printable coloring page, both spreading their arms and lifting their feet above the gently rolling ground. A row of pointed mountain peaks stretches behind the pair, with three rounded clouds and broad open spaces keeping the landscape simple.

pages.title: Peppa Pig Daddy Pig Resting By Water Coloring Page
pages.description: Daddy Pig rests beside the water in this printable coloring page, reclining on a striped beach mat in a sun hat beneath a large outlined sun. A paneled beach ball sits beside him, with two coconut palms, small stones, gentle waves, grass tufts, and clouds completing the shoreline scene.
